meta.description: High-level agent tool -> RDR2 TASK/AUDIO/PED native mapping candidate list

natives.name: TASK_WANDER_STANDARD
natives.comment: Makes ped walk around the area. set p1 to 10.0f and p2 to 10 if you want the ped to walk anywhere without a duration.

natives.name: TASK_FOLLOW_NAV_MESH_TO_COORD
natives.comment: If no timeout, set timeout to -1.

natives.name: TASK_GO_STRAIGHT_TO_COORD
natives.comment: Go to coords wihtout using navmesh, if timeBeforeTeleport is -1 then it never teleports p8 is 1 or 0 still unknown.

natives.name: CLEAR_PED_TASKS_IMMEDIATELY
natives.comment: Immediately stops the pedestrian from whatever it's doing. They stop fighting, animations, etc. they forget what they were doing. resetCrouch TRUE = ped will stand up if crouching, FALSE = ped will remain crouching if crouched

natives.name: TASK_PAUSE
natives.comment: This tasks the ped to do nothing for the specified amount of milliseconds. This is useful if you want to add a delay between tasks when using a sequence task.

natives.name: TASK_STAND_STILL
natives.comment: Makes the specified ped stand still for (time) milliseconds.

natives.name: TASK_PAUSE
natives.comment: This tasks the ped to do nothing for the specified amount of milliseconds. This is useful if you want to add a delay between tasks when using a sequence task.

natives.name: TASK_STAND_STILL
natives.comment: Makes the specified ped stand still for (time) milliseconds.

natives.name: TASK_LOOK_AT_ENTITY
natives.comment: param3: duration in ms, use -1 to look forever param4: using 2048 is fine param5: using 3 is fine

natives.name: TASK_TURN_PED_TO_FACE_ENTITY
natives.comment: duration: the amount of time in milliseconds to do the task. -1 will keep the task going until either another task is applied, or CLEAR_ALL_TASKS() is called with the ped

natives.name: TASK_ACHIEVE_HEADING
natives.comment: Makes the specified ped achieve the specified heading. pedHandle: The handle of the ped to assign the task to. heading: The desired heading. timeout: The time, in milliseconds, to allow the task to complete. If the task times out, it is canceled, and the ped will stay at the heading it managed to reach in the time.

natives.name: TASK_TURN_PED_TO_FACE_COORD
natives.comment: duration in milliseconds

natives.name: TASK_ACHIEVE_HEADING
natives.comment: Makes the specified ped achieve the specified heading. pedHandle: The handle of the ped to assign the task to. heading: The desired heading. timeout: The time, in milliseconds, to allow the task to complete. If the task times out, it is canceled, and the ped will stay at the heading it managed to reach in the time.

natives.name: PLAY_PED_AMBIENT_SPEECH_NATIVE
natives.comment: struct ScriptedSpeechParams { const char* speechName; const char* voiceName; alignas(8) int variation; alignas(8) Hash speechParamHash; alignas(8) Ped listenerPed; alignas(8) BOOL syncOverNetwork; alignas(8) int v7; alignas(8) int v8; }; static_assert(sizeof(ScriptedSpeechParams) == 0x40, "incorrect ScriptedSpeechParams size"); Example: ScriptedSpeechParams params{"RE_PH_RHD_V3_AGGRO", "0405_U_M_M_RhdSheriff_01", 1, joaat("SPEECH_PARAMS_BEAT_SHOUTED_CLEAR"), 0, true, 1, 1}; PLAY_PED_AMBIENT_SPEE

natives.name: _CREATE_NEW_SCRIPTED_PED_AMBIENT_SPEECH
natives.comment: Create a scripted speech to control speech. If handle is less than 0, it's invalid. params struct for ScriptedSpeechParams see: PLAY_PED_AMBIENT_SPEECH_NATIVE Returns scriptedSpeech handle.

natives.name: _PLAY_SOUND_FROM_SCRIPTED_PED_AMBIENT_SPEECH
natives.comment: Play/advance a scripted speech created via _CREATE_NEW_SCRIPTED_PED_AMBIENT_SPEECH and return a status code. Return values: 0 = not ready/invalid/failed 1 = started/playing 2 = finished/consumed (you can drop the handle) Typical usage: poll this in a tick after creating the speech; when it returns 2, clear your handle.

natives.comment: https://github.com/femga/rdr3_discoveries/tree/master/animations flags: https://github.com/Halen84/RDR3-Native-Flags-And-Enums/tree/main/eScriptedAnimFlags ikFlags: https://github.com/Halen84/RDR3-Native-Flags-And-Enums/tree/main/eIkControlFlags

natives.name: TASK_PLAY_ANIM_ADVANCED
natives.comment: flags: see TASK_PLAY_ANIM ikFlags: see TASK_PLAY_ANIM

natives.name: TASK_PLAY_EMOTE_WITH_HASH
natives.comment: https://github.com/femga/rdr3_discoveries/blob/master/animations/kit_emotes_list.lua emote: https://alloc8or.re/rdr3/doc/enums/eEmote.txt enum eEmoteType { EMOTE_TYPE_INVALID = -1, EMOTE_TYPE_REACT, EMOTE_TYPE_ACTION, EMOTE_TYPE_TAUNT, EMOTE_TYPE_GREET, EMOTE_TYPE_TWIRL_GUN, EMOTE_TYPE_DANCE_FLOOR }; enum eEmotePlaybackMode { EMOTE_PM_INVALID = -1, EMOTE_PM_UPPERBODY, EMOTE_PM_UPPERBODY_LOOP, EMOTE_PM_FULLBODY, };

natives.name: _TASK_PLAY_EMOTE
natives.comment: Similar to 0xB31A277C1AC7B7FF but checks if the ped's inventory contains the specified emote kit.

natives.name: _TASK_EMOTE_ACTION
natives.comment: Triggers the 'action / flourish' sub-clip of the ped's currently playing emote. Returns true on success, false if no valid emote state. Observed in ingame UIs to fire a flourish while an emote loop is active. Internally resets the ped's synced-emote entity and sets a flag to play the action once.

natives.name: TASK_START_SCENARIO_IN_PLACE_HASH
natives.comment: https://github.com/femga/rdr3_discoveries/blob/master/animations/scenarios Params: duration in milliseconds conditionalHash (optionally): 0 = play random conditional anim. Every conditional anim has requirements to play it. If requirements are not met, ped plays random allowed conditional anim or can be stuck. For example, this scenario type has possible conditional anim WORLD_HUMAN_LEAN_BACK_WALL_SMOKING_MALE_D, but it can not be played by player, because condition is set to NOT be CAICondition

natives.name: TASK_REACT
natives.comment: Makes a ped react to an entity. Params: reactingTo Entity can be 0, p8 is always 4

natives.name: TASK_HANDS_UP
natives.comment: flags: 0 = HANDS_UP_NOTHING; 1 = HANDS_UP_STRAIGHT_TO_LOOP

natives.name: TASK_KNOCKED_OUT_AND_HOGTIED
natives.comment: koTimeOffset (seconds): offset applied to the knockout timer-positive delays recovery (longer KO), negative brings recovery sooner, 0.0 initializes with no extension (immediate baseline). flags (bitmask): 1 = default variant (forwarded to the KO task ctor; R* commonly uses 1), 2 = sets an unk internal synced toggle for this task, 4 = sets another unk internal synced toggle.

natives.name: TASK_FLEE_PED
natives.comment: Params: p4 = -1.0f, p5 = -1, p6 = 0 in R* Scripts fleeStyle: see TASK_FLEE_COORD

natives.name: TASK_SMART_FLEE_PED
natives.comment: Makes a ped run away from another ped (fleeFromTarget) fleeDistance = ped will flee this distance fleeTime = ped will flee for this amount of time, set to "-1" to flee forever fleeType = see TASK_FLEE_COORD, can be 0, R* Scripts: fm_mission/race_controller: 66048; fme_escaped_convicts: 2260992, 2523136, 2359296; la_alligator/fox: 2097152; net_fetch: 17301536; net_stable_mount: 540928 fleeSpeed = mostly 3f, rarely 1f in R* Scripts

natives.name: TASK_FLEE_COORD
natives.comment: Params: p5 = some flag?, p6 = -1.0f, p8 = 0 in R* Scripts fleeStyle: https://github.com/Halen84/RDR3-Native-Flags-And-Enums/tree/main/eFleeStyle

natives.name: TASK_SMART_FLEE_COORD
natives.comment: Makes the specified ped flee the specified distance from the specified position. fleeType: see TASK_FLEE_COORD

natives.name: START_TASK_ITEM_INTERACTION
natives.comment: Params: p3 = 0, 1; p5 = 0.0f, -1.0f https://github.com/femga/rdr3_discoveries/tree/master/tasks/TASK_ITEM_INTERACTION

natives.name: TASK_MOUNT_ANIMAL
natives.comment: timer: in ms, if it reaches 0 it will auto warp the ped on the horse mountStyle: See TASK_ENTER_VEHICLE Flags will still apply to mountStyle

natives.name: TASK_ENTER_VEHICLE
natives.comment: flags: https://github.com/Halen84/RDR3-Native-Flags-And-Enums/tree/main/eEnterExitVehicleFlags

natives.name: TASK_DISMOUNT_ANIMAL
natives.comment: Dismounts the ped from the animal it's mounted on. taskFlag affects what side the rider gets off. p2-p5 are almost always 0. flags: See TASK_ENTER_VEHICLE

natives.name: TASK_LEAVE_VEHICLE
natives.comment: flags: See TASK_ENTER_VEHICLE
